Semantic summary: a battle-presentation sub-effect. Sets BG2 scale, registers two draw-order callbacks (0x080DBB9D and 0x080CD261) and the kind-46/47 draw-rectangle pair via Func_080cef64, computes a BG-offset MMIO write from the fixed first party member's stat (object+0x24), seeds a 16-entry 'star' array at work+0x7080 with randomized velocity/angle fields, then runs a fixed 54-frame loop. Frame 10 re-cues the first member's portrait/voice line. Frames 8-53 grow (then shrink) a horizontal progress-bar rectangle drawn in two 14px segments through the kind-46 callback cached at heap_cache[7]. Every frame also walks the 16-entry star array: once a star's index-derived readiness threshold is reached and its lifetime counter is still low, it looks up two 7-entry pixel tables by a Func_080022ec-clamped bucket and draws a shrinking icon through the Func_080cef64-supplied callback array's first entry.

After correcting Func_080e3980's three-word output, the candidate and reference have identical 772-byte extents. The remaining large-scale hunks begin with the prologue's heap_cache/cursor register choice and match the same open, cross-family-documented compiler-allocator sensitivity already recorded in games/gs1/recon/en/main/080dc1ec.json and 080d59b0.json for this exact 0x03001eec subsystem -- not pursued further per the ban on forcing register or stack assignment.
